scripts.check: npm run check --workspaces --if-present && tsc -p e2e/tsconfig.json && tsc -p tests/parity/tsconfig.json
scripts.test: npm run test --workspaces --if-present && vitest run -c tests/parity/vitest.config.mts
scripts.e2e: npm run build && node scripts/demo-assets.mjs && node scripts/e2e-assets.mjs && playwright test
scripts.e2e:chromium: npm run build && node scripts/e2e-assets.mjs && playwright test --project=chromium
scripts.release: npm run check && npm run test && npm run build && changeset publish
scripts.e2e:ssr: npm run build && node scripts/ssr-apps.mjs && ADT_SSR=1 playwright test e2e/ssr.spec.ts
scripts.e2e:visual: npm run build && ADT_VISUAL=1 playwright test e2e/visual.spec.ts --project=chromium
